description: One row per user recording whether they have been through the setup wizard and the interactive app guide, plus the preferences the wizard collected. Import TWENTY-SIXTH (no dependencies)
notes: ONE ROW PER USER. The client reads by user_id, then PATCHes if found or POSTs if not. Baserow cannot enforce uniqueness, so on a double-POST race OnboardingService takes the highest id and leaves the orphan - a duplicate onboarding row is harmless.

THERE IS NO 'pending' ROW. status is only ever written as 'skipped' or 'completed'. The ABSENCE of a row is what pending means, and that is what makes the backfill work: every existing user already has no row, so they are all pending with no migration script.
user_id is plain text holding String(user.id), NOT a link field. Users live in Xano, not Baserow - see 00-import-order.md. Same convention as tables 15-22 and level_records.

ONLY A GENUINE HTTP 200 MAY CONCLUDE pending. BaserowService.skip() emits an EMPTY RESULT SET rather than throwing when the table id is 0 or the token is missing, and an empty result is byte-identical to 'this user has no row'. OnboardingService therefore tracks a tri-state load ('loaded' vs 'unavailable') and mirrors everything to localStorage. Get this wrong and the wizard reappears on every load, for everyone, forever.

FORGEABLE. The Baserow API token ships in the client bundle, so any user can flip their own onboarding_completed. That is fine for what this table is - it decides whether to show a wizard. NEVER gate an entitlement, a trial, a paywall or anything paid on these fields.

preferences / starter_habits / guide_steps_seen / page_tips_seen are JSON in long_text columns rather than Baserow's json type - the same choice level_records made for detail. It round-trips as a plain string through the generic row helpers with no surprises, and versioning a blob is cheaper than migrating columns.
wizard_version and guide_version exist so a redesigned wizard or tour can be legitimately re-offered to users who completed the old one, without a data migration. Nothing reads them yet.

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string

status.description: 'pending' is listed for completeness but is never written - absence of a row means pending

starter_habits.description: JSON array of habit-library ids the wizard actually created

guide_step_index.description: Resume point when guide_status is in_progress

guide_steps_seen.description: JSON array of TourStep ids already shown

page_tips_seen.description: JSON array of route keys whose first-visit tip has been shown

completed_at.description: When the wizard was finished or skipped

updated_at.description: Touched on every write, including guide progress
